description: This file defines an Express middleware function 'extractOrganization' that extracts organization identifiers from HTTP requests, manages scope for super admins and tenants, and attaches helper functions and properties to the request object for downstream use.

methods.name: extractOrganization
methods.description: Returns an Express middleware function that extracts organization ID from request headers, query parameters, or body, handles super admin bypass, and sets request properties for scoping.
